raw.summary: Cricut, Inc. engages in the design, marketing, and distribution of a creativity platform that enables users to turn ideas into professional-looking handmade goods in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, Western Europe, the Middle East, Latin America, South Africa, and Asia. It operates through Platform and Products segments.
